name: strata-provider
description: Contributes the ai-lab strata server's models to the VS Code model picker via the stable Language Model Chat Provider API (fully local BYOK).

strata.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of the strata server (stack-network alias, not host loopback).

strata.apiKey.description: API key for strata. Leave empty to read STRATA_API_KEY from the server environment (injected by the quadlet EnvironmentFile).

strata.contextWindow.description: Fallback context window (tokens) when the server does not report meta.n_ctx per model.

strata.maxOutputTokens.description: Max output tokens per response. Keep generous: strata reasoning models share this budget with thinking.

strata.toolCalling.description: Declare tool-calling support (agent mode lists only tool-capable models).

strata.imageInput.description: Fallback vision flag when the server does not report architecture.input_modalities.

strata.modelAllowlist.description: If non-empty, only expose these model ids from GET /models.
